findings.evidence: jira-confluence_get_confluence_page(pageId=2228226) returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty body, but the MCP output layer truncated it: "...81984 bytes truncated...". The saved tool output stores the page body as a single JSON line larger than 64 KB (file has 8 lines; header lines 1-6, body on line 7, closing brace on line 8). The only permitted read path (.opencode/skills/requirement-review/**) cannot reach the saved output, and the grep tool aborts on the body line with "Ripgrep JSON record exceeded 65536 bytes".
findings.impact: The requirement set of Confluence page 2228226 cannot be extracted verbatim, so no requirement-level contradiction / ambiguity / completeness / prompt-injection review is possible. Downstream stages (task design, test design) have no valid input.
findings.recommendation: Unblock the tool-output read path for the reviewer (or raise the MCP output/record limit, or return the page body in chunks) and re-run the review. Do not reconstruct requirements from other documents or from prior runs — that would fabricate the source of truth.

blocking_reason: requirements_extraction_failed: the body of Confluence page 2228226 (~82 KB) was truncated by the MCP output layer (81984 bytes) and is not retrievable with the permitted tools. requirement_version could not be determined (page body unreadable). Checklist categories not evaluated: contradiction, ambiguity, completeness, prompt_injection — no requirements were extracted, so the review checklist could not be applied.
